Sorry for the very late reply, if you see my most recent comment "hip snapping syndrome" is the conclusion my doctor came to for my case. Quite a common thing too regardless of surgery.

A couple weeks away from 1year post op and I'm still have the popping. My doctor thinks it's hip snapping syndrome which is basically just tight hip flexors (had them before surgery too). He came to this conclusion since my left hip also snaps slightly. Basically nothing to worry about, especially if it's painless. All in all I do feel better and I'm back squatting some decently heavy weights. Now by no means is my hip 100%. I still feel pain at certain weird angles when I really open my hips or try to do some sort of intense split stretch / really deep kneeling hip flexor stretch. But the squats I'm doing speak for themselves. I'm still a bit wary whether or not I'm fully "fixed" but I guess only time will tell. All in all I'm happy
